name: Ikemen★Celeb Mansion ~Kiken na Maid Seikatsu~
original_name: イケメン★セレブマンション～危険なメイド生活～
source:
One day, the protagonist who worked at an ordinary cafe, accidentally spilled coffee on a male customer.

Although his suit was perfectly tailored and looked expensive, the man showed no irritation, and while one would normally ask for compensation, he had only one request...

It seemed like it'd be a one-time thing, but...!
This marks the start of a spicy life as a maid under one roof with handsome celebrity brothers!

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20180901125600/http://auragame.jp/contents/contents/red/celeb.php]official website[/url]]
